value.rationale: Shared-time quantum averaging generally does not factor across network coordinates. Hub-and-spoke Cartesian networks offer natural transport devices: the theorem supplies exact all-coupling spectrum, kernel, a robust positivity threshold and a finite signed-resonance arrangement. A \(P_3\) factor forces singular mixing even when all other stars are individually full rank, while a 12-vertex mixed box has three sharply distinct resonant ranks 8, 9 and 10. This natural complete classification isolates what spectral degeneracies do to long-time information transport; it is not an arbitrary tiny parameter slice.
